# CI/CD & Site Deployment Walkthrough

This document records the architectural blueprint, package structure, and GitHub Pages deployment workflow for the **metabr** (v0.2.4) documentation infrastructure.

---

## 1. Documentation Architecture & Blueprint

### Purpose

Provide comprehensive documentation infrastructure across the `foundr` / systems genetics ecosystem (`metabr`, `modulr`, `foundrHarmony`) detailing codebase architecture, function indexes, quality control / data flow methodology, and automated deployment via `pkgdown` and GitHub Actions.

### Architecture Specifications

1. **Root Guide ([`DEVELOPER.md`](../../DEVELOPER.md))**:
   - High-level package introduction, ecosystem role, directory structure, function reference, developer quick start (`devtools::load_all()`), and release guidelines.

2. **Vignettes & Articles (`vignettes/devel_guide/`)**:
   - [`index.Rmd`](index.html): Overview, ecosystem integration flowchart, and local development commands.
   - [`qc_pipeline.Rmd`](qc_pipeline.html): In-depth methodology detailing mathematical formulations, algorithm stages, sub-flowcharts, and S3 class diagnostic routines.
   - [`data_ingestion.Rmd`](data_ingestion.html): Data format specifications, column schemas, parser functions, and export routines.
   - [`deployment.Rmd`](deployment.html): This CI/CD architecture and publishing walkthrough.

3. **`pkgdown` Site Configuration ([`_pkgdown.yml`](../../_pkgdown.yml))**:
   - Bootstrap 5 template.
   - Dynamic Mermaid JS v10 flowchart rendering header block.
   - Custom **Developer Guide** navbar dropdown menu linking to rendered HTML articles.
   - Categorized function reference sections.

4. **GitHub Actions Deployment ([`.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml`](../../.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml))**:
   - Automated workflow to build `pkgdown` site in CI/CD and deploy HTML assets directly to the **`gh-pages`** branch.
   - Configured [`.gitignore`](../../.gitignore) (`docs/`) and [`.Rbuildignore`](../../.Rbuildignore).

---

## 2. Package File Structure

The documentation and CI/CD assets are organized as follows:

| File Path | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`DEVELOPER.md`](../../DEVELOPER.md) | Primary developer guide detailing package architecture, mass spectrometry raw input formats, QC correction mathematics, S3 class definitions, testing procedures, and release guidelines. |
| [`vignettes/devel_guide/index.Rmd`](index.html) | High-level developer overview, package purpose, local quick start, and top-level end-to-end Mermaid flowchart. |
| [`vignettes/devel_guide/qc_pipeline.Rmd`](qc_pipeline.html) | Technical reference detailing the 4-stage quality control correction algorithm (`qc_steps()`), correction factor ($\text{CF}$) formulas, retention time (`medRt`) handling, and `hand_auto()` curation discrepancy analysis. |
| [`vignettes/devel_guide/data_ingestion.Rmd`](data_ingestion.html) | Data specifications detailing raw CSV/Excel parsers, minute time-course loaders, long-format tidy data frame schemas, and `write_metab()` export rules. |
| [`vignettes/devel_guide/deployment.Rmd`](deployment.html) | Deployment and CI/CD architecture walkthrough. |
| [`_pkgdown.yml`](../../_pkgdown.yml) | `pkgdown` configuration with Bootstrap 5 styling, dynamic Mermaid JS v10 flowchart rendering block in headers, custom navbar, and organized function reference sections. |
| [`.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml`](../../.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml) | Automated GitHub Actions workflow to build and deploy the `pkgdown` documentation site to the `gh-pages` branch on every push to `master`. |
| [`.gitignore`](../../.gitignore) | Added `docs/` to `.gitignore` to prevent generated site files from cluttering the source branch. |
| [`.Rbuildignore`](../../.Rbuildignore) | Updated to ignore `_pkgdown.yml`, `.github`, `DEVELOPER.md`, and `docs` during package builds. |
| [`DESCRIPTION`](../../DESCRIPTION) | Package metadata and documentation URL (`https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/metabr`). |

---

## 3. Local Verification

To preview the documentation site locally before pushing:

```r
# Build pkgdown documentation site locally
pkgdown::build_site(install = FALSE)
```

## 4. GitHub Pages Publishing Instructions

1. **Commit and Push Source Files**:
   ```bash
   git add .gitignore .Rbuildignore _pkgdown.yml .github/ DESCRIPTION vignettes/ DEVELOPER.md
   git commit -m "Update developer guides and deployment workflow"
   git push origin master
   ```

2. **Enable GitHub Pages**:
   - Go to `https://github.com/byandell-sysgen/metabr/settings/pages`
   - Set **Source** to `Deploy from a branch` $\rightarrow$ Branch **`gh-pages`** and folder **`/ (root)`**.
